main_text.p: μάτος[?] .i.suffitu , quod gratisimum Deo sacrificium sit herbarum incensarum & naturalium odorum vapor & suffitus:non autem iugulatæ pecudes & mactatæ.Id quod sensit quoque Pythagoras.Sed errat vterque. Nec enim propter rem ipsam,quæ offerebatur, Deo grata sacrificia fuerunt: sed propter fidem , id est , propter præceptum Dei & finem offerentis.Is autem erat attestatio futuri Christi, Augustin. libr. 20. Contra Faust. cap. 23. Sed ita reposita est nobis per hæreticos omnis Paganorum hominum infania:& omnium errorum crambe, quæ nos enecat,&,vt est in veteri prouerbio, mors est.
main_text.head: CAP. XXIX.
Teffareskædecatitæ cur sic nominati. Eorum autem hypothesis vna recensetur.
main_text.p: Effareskædecatitæ{1} hinc appellati sunt, quod non nisi quartadecima{2} luna, mense Martio Pæscha celebrant, quilibet e septè occurrat dies: & si dies Dominicus occurrerit, ipso die ieiunant & vigilant.

{1} Teffareskædecatitæ.) Græca vox est, quàm Latini Theologi Quartidecimanos vertunt. Ac quo tempore grauis illa de die Paschatis celebrandi controuersia primùm in Ecclesia coeperit, anxia quæstio est, & authores alij ab aliis dissentiunt. Isidorus demum post Heluidianos hæreticos collocat, quasi post 300. à Christo passo

page.notes: The Greek word at the start of the first paragraph is only partly legible in the scan; read as "ματος" with a doubtful first letter. Reference mark {2} after "quartadecima" has no matching note printed on this page. The footnote runs on past the last visible word "passo", which is the page's final line. The woodcut initial is an E, and the title line "Teffareskædecatitæ" in the footnote is printed in Latin letters, kept as printed.
